newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat rises on storm worries.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat rises on storm worries.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat rose in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange amid concern that recent storms might reduce crop output and quality, traders said.

March wheat rose $4 to $136, farmer prices. But government officials said that they would not know until Monday how much damage has been done. April cash wheat was unchanged in thin trade at $97. May cash soybeans firmed $3 to $236, with some nerves over the effect of the weather on crops. March sunflower seed was unchanged at $210 in thin trade.
